Attention, everyone: #GlobalCitizenFestival is heading south – all the way to Belém, Brazil! On November 1, we’re bringing our impact concert to the Amazon with headliners @anitta , @SeuJorge , and @GabyAmarantos , speakers including Chief Raoni Metuktire, and a special guest performance from Coldplay’s Chris Martin. And it’s all in support of #ProtectTheAmazon, our biggest climate campaign to date. Learn more about why we’re heading to Brazil – and what’s in store – at our website! See you in Belém ⁠
_____________________________________________________________________
Global Citizen is a social action platform for a global generation that aims to solve the world’s biggest challenges. On our platform, you can learn about issues, take action on what matters most, and join a community committed to social change. We believe we can end extreme poverty because of the collective actions of Global Citizens across the world.
